headlines.text: Looking back to 2025, when Kazuchika Okada vs. Mike Bailey met in a Continental Classic League Match, closing out the card as the main event on Collision, rated 8.15 ? a genuinely great match, on an outstanding Christmas Collision '25 show that earned an overall rating of 8.82. In a tournament-defining main event, Bailey blocked a Rainmaker and nearly stole the win with a unique pinning combination, but Okada countered into a sit-down pin to punch his ticket to the Continental Classic semifinals as Blue League winner Takeshita stared him down after the bell.

Flash back to 2024, when Kyle Fletcher vs. Daniel Garcia met in a Continental Classic League Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Dynamite, rated 7.96 ? a solid showing ? part of a stacked Dynamite on 34th Street '24 card, rated 8.40 overall.
